intro.title: React.memo
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React application with two counter components to see how React.memo optimizes performance. You will learn the core concept of memoization, which prevents unnecessary re-renders of a component when its props haven't changed. The main technologies involved are React functional components, TypeScript for type safety, and the React.memo higher-order component. By the end, you'll understand when and how to use React.memo to make your apps faster and more efficient.
intro.usecase: React.memo is essential in real-world applications where performance optimization matters, such as large data dashboards with multiple updating panels or complex forms with many interactive fields. For example, in financial trading platforms where real-time price updates flow through multiple components, memoizing chart panels prevents unnecessary re-renders when unrelated UI elements change. Similarly, in e-commerce product filters with dozens of selectable options, memoizing filter components ensures smooth user interactions by avoiding re-renders when other parts of the page update. Developers use React.memo strategically in these scenarios to maintain responsive interfaces while managing complex state changes.
